title: PicoLimbo Plugin Manifest
description: Manifest schema for PicoLimbo Plugin API version 1. Validate the parsed TOML document against this schema.

id.description: Unique plugin identifier. It must match the plugin directory name.

api_version.description: PicoLimbo Plugin API version targeted by this plugin.

entrypoint.description: Script entrypoint relative to the plugin directory. Defaults to main.rhai for Rhai and main.lua for Lua. Parent-directory traversal and absolute paths are rejected.

commands.description: Commands registered by this plugin. Requires commands.register.

permissions.description: Explicit host capabilities. Unlisted permissions are denied.

runtime.description: Script runtime. Lua requires a PicoLimbo build with the plugin-lua Cargo feature.
